title: A robust theorem does not acquire its model-error allowance
statement: On SAME input law and sensing interface, actual F=F0+e,||e||L2<=delta gives achievable risk<=(sqrt(R0)+delta)^2 and EVERY fixed risk>=(sqrt(L0)-delta)_+^2. It neither certifies delta nor repairs different observation/noise law. Fresh full-input holdout with actual target/reference evaluations and supplied Ee^4<=K(Ee^2)^2 uses b=ceil(16K) residuals/block, smallest odd t>=8ln(1/beta), median Me and confidence interval Ee^2 in[(2/3)Me,2Me]. Finite residual-evaluation error<=tau gives delta_cert=sqrt2(sqrt(Mtilde)+tau). Costs bt full-input samples, target/reference evaluations and all traffic; rare unseen errors defeat unqualified finite checks. No external system-membership experiment executed. Configured-shunt Astra interface was retrieved and rejected as transfer: new configurable couplings and bounded SPD source law do not supply unbounded Gaussian Hermite apparatus, and native quadratic-value access is already a direct-target comparator.

requires: Actual F=F0+e on SAME input distribution AND observation/noise law as reference theorem,with an actually supplied/certified L2 error delta.

Optional holdout certificate needs fresh independent full-input residual evaluations and justified Ee^4<=K(Ee^2)^2;actual target/reference/evaluation/traffic costs and finite residual error tau charged. Moment promise is not inferred from passing holdout.
Configured-shunt source has its own configurable coupling and bounded-SPD law; it is a rejected transfer,not a supplied Gaussian Hermite sensor.

assumptions: Completed new P1 original-source mathematical final, distinct from the preceding Gaussian-quadratic two-round release. Existing substantive internal audits are carried at their exact shared-context scopes; no blind replication or Capital scientific reproof/replay is inferred. Conditional-linear Gaussian value identity needs retained C at final predictor and HARD read/control budgets with every informative side channel charged. Exact exponential-codebook value is not efficient optimization. Known Hermite layout and adequate calibration/model law are substantive. The r=128 theorem and r=64 synthetic acquired run are distinct; fixed-read 2697 is a NECESSARY lower bound, not an attained optimum. Dense actuator generation/application, readout/direction precision and equally informed direct-target/full-input costs remain. No physical apparatus, generic layout learner, computational speedup or demonstrated practical total-cost advantage. Original truthful Jackowski access failure remains unchanged; later coordinator primary-source scope annotation resolves only componentwise-versus-cross-block premise, not historical priority.
costs: Codebook may have 2^B entries and exponential storage/search; exact value theorem supplies no cheap compiler or conditional-mean oracle. First-stage information, full return precision, local arithmetic, direction generation and physical aggregate access remain separate.

r=128 theorem: 129 reads, 1408 context/control bits,16-bit final ADC and 165,120-bit local program applying 8,256 weights. Local 20M-bit encoding is an upper bound, not a necessary actuator-state lower bound.

r=64 synthetic calibration pays 2,080 scalar calls with absolute error 1e-7, 4,326,400 feature entries, 8,652,800 target products and 16,640-byte prepared model; deployment 65 reads and 2,080 dense aggregate products. Full-input/direct-target alternatives receive same information and actual noise/cost.
